tests.command:
set -eu
docker image inspect -f 'id={{.Id}} platform={{.Os}}/{{.Architecture}} user={{.Config.User}} entrypoint={{json .Config.Entrypoint}} env={{json .Config.Env}}' jenkins:2.583-alpine-loongarch64
docker run --rm --entrypoint /bin/sh jenkins:2.583-alpine-loongarch64 -c 'set -eu; java -version; java -XshowSettings:properties -version 2>&1 | grep -F "java.vm.name = OpenJDK 64-Bit Server VM"; apk info -e openjdk25-loongarch-jre-headless; apk info -e openjdk25-loongarch-jre; test -r /usr/lib/jvm/java-25-openjdk/lib/server/libjvm.so; test -r /usr/lib/jvm/java-25-openjdk/lib/libfontmanager.so; java -jar /usr/share/jenkins/jenkins.war --version'

set -eu
name=jenkins-2583-smoke
trap 'docker rm -fv "$name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
docker rm -fv "$name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
docker run -d --name "$name" --network none -e JAVA_OPTS=-Djenkins.install.runSetupWizard=false -e JENKINS_OPTS=--httpPort=8080 jenkins:2.583-alpine-loongarch64 >/dev/null
ready=0
for i in $(seq 1 90); do
  code=$(docker exec "$name" curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8080/login 2>/dev/null || true)
  if [ "$code" = 200 ] || [ "$code" = 403 ]; then
    echo "Jenkins HTTP /login returned $code"
    ready=1
    break
  fi
  if [ "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$name" 2>/dev/null || true)" != true ]; then
    echo 'Jenkins container exited before readiness'
    docker logs "$name" 2>&1 || true
    exit 1
  fi
  sleep 2
done
if [ "$ready" != 1 ]; then
  echo 'Jenkins did not become ready within 180 seconds'
  docker logs "$name" 2>&1 || true
  exit 1
fi
docker logs "$name" 2>&1 | tail -n 80
docker logs "$name" 2>&1 | grep -F 'Jenkins is fully up and running' >/dev/null

dependencies.name: Alpine LoongArch64 base image
dependencies.consumer: Both stages in the final Dockerfile

dependencies.name: OpenJDK 25 LoongArch JRE packages
dependencies.source: Configured Alpine v3.24 main/community LoongArch APK repositories
dependencies.consumer: Controller Java runtime; headless package provides the verified Server VM and companion JRE package provides libfontmanager.so

dependencies.name: Jenkins WAR
dependencies.verification: Official SHA-256 sidecar and Jenkins GPG signature verified with jenkins.io-2026.key

dependencies.name: Jenkins Plugin Installation Manager
dependencies.verification: Official release SHA-256 sidecar verified; archive contains no native libraries or executables

environment_assumptions: Docker daemon builds LoongArch64 layers natively
Host networking is available to the build so Alpine package repositories can be reached
Build context is the Jenkins repository root
The lcr.loongnix.cn/library/alpine:latest tag may resolve to a newer image than the one recorded here
Artifact acquisition endpoints are reachable when preparing the build context
applicability.runtime: Runs as user jenkins with ports 8080 and 50000 and JENKINS_HOME=/var/jenkins_home; validated with networking disabled, /login HTTP 200 and the fully-up log message
